messages.subject: 502 Bad Gateway
parts:
Hi,

When I try to deploy my Shiny app I get this error message: 

deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...

Error: /v1/applications/23488/upload 502 - <html>
<head><title>502 Bad Gateway</title></head>
<body bgcolor="white">
<center><h1>502 Bad Gateway</h1></center>
<hr><center>nginx/1.4.2</center>
</body>
</html>

I tried terminating my app and redeploying it based on comments I saw from people with the 502 Bad Gateway error, but I still got the error message. Any ideas?

Thanks in advance,
Sarah
